privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.subtitle: Effective Date: September 17, 2026
privacyPolicy.intro: My Favorite Aunts ("we," "us," or "our") is committed to protecting the privacy of the families we serve. This Privacy Policy explains what personal information we collect through this website, how we use it, and the choices you have. By submitting a form on this site, you agree to the practices described here.

collect.heading: Information We Collect
collect.intro: We collect personal information directly from you when you voluntarily submit a form on this site:
items: Contact form: your name, email address, phone number, and the message you send us.
Enrollment inquiry form: the parent or guardian's name, email address, and phone number; each child's age; your preferred start date; and any additional notes you choose to share.
collect.outro: We do not collect this information through cookies, tracking pixels, or any automated means, and we do not use third-party analytics or advertising services on this site.

use.heading: How We Use Your Information
use.body: We use the information you provide solely to respond to your inquiry, process enrollment requests, and communicate with you about our programs. We do not use your information for marketing unrelated to your inquiry, and we do not sell or rent your personal information to anyone.

cookies.heading: Cookies & Local Storage
cookies.body: This site does not use tracking cookies. It uses your browser's local storage only to remember your preferred language (English or Spanish) across visits — this preference never leaves your device. If you are a staff member, our admin area also uses local storage to keep you signed in; this is used only by authorized staff, not by visiting families.

children.heading: Children's Privacy
children.body: We collect only minimal information about children — specifically, age — and only from a parent or guardian who voluntarily submits it through our enrollment inquiry form. We do not knowingly collect information directly from children, and this website is not directed at or intended for use by children.

sharing.heading: Sharing of Information
sharing.body: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. We may share information with service providers who help us operate this website (such as our hosting and database providers) solely to the extent necessary to provide our services, and only under obligations to keep it confidential. We may also disclose information if required to do so by law.

retention.heading: Data Retention
retention.body: We retain the information you submit for as long as reasonably necessary to respond to your inquiry, process your enrollment, and maintain our business records, unless you request that we delete it sooner.

security.heading: Security
security.body: We take reasonable measures to protect your information, including rate-limiting form submissions to prevent abuse and securely hashing staff passwords. However, no method of electronic storage or transmission is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

rights.heading: Your Rights & Choices
rights.body: You may contact us at any time to ask what information we have about you, to request a correction, or to request that we delete it. We will respond to reasonable requests promptly.

changes.heading: Changes to This Policy
changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with a revised effective date.

contact.heading: Contact Us
contact.body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your information, please contact us:

privacyPolicy.disclaimer: This Privacy Policy is a template for demonstration purposes and does not constitute legal advice. Please have it reviewed by a qualified attorney before using it for an actual business.
